# Jenil Moradiya (Im2Jenil)

> Jenil Moradiya, also known online as Im2Jenil, is a diploma student in Computer Engineering from Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He builds Discord bots, does hosting and server-side work, helps run Discord communities, and is learning cloud engineering (AWS, Microsoft Azure, IPv4 networking).
